other_exits: Historical bar scan: if no direct signal close on SignalBar, scans backward from SignalBar+1 through all bars to find the most recent opposite signal to determine close direction. This acts as a position-direction-aware close: if currently long and no down-signal on current bar, searches history for last down-signal to close long.

params.description: MM=-0.1 means negative value = fixed lot size of 0.1; positive value = deposit share fraction

position_sizing.conditional_logic: If MM < 0, abs(MM) is the fixed lot size; if MM > 0, MM is the fraction of deposit used per deal

custom_logic_notes: The EA uses a custom composite indicator 'ColorX2MA-Parabolic' which combines a double-smoothed moving average (X2MA with two cascading smoothing stages using methods from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh — supports SMA/EMA/SMMA/LWMA/JJMA/JurX/ParMA/T3/VIDYA/AMA) with a dual-parameter Parabolic SAR (separate Step/Maximum for highs and lows). Entry signals come from indicator buffers: buffer 3 = uptrend dot (buy signal), buffer 2 = downtrend dot (sell signal). The EA has a historical bar scan fallback for determining close signals when no direct signal is present on the current SignalBar. Trade execution is delegated to TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose). SignalBar=1 means signals are read from the previous closed bar (not the forming bar). BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose are boolean gates that can independently disable entry or exit directions.
python_conversion_notes: Must reimplement the ColorX2MA-Parabolic indicator in Python. The X2MA component requires two-stage smoothing with configurable methods (JJMA, JurX, T3, VIDYA, AMA are non-standard and need custom implementations — only SMA/EMA/SMMA/LWMA have trivial numpy equivalents). The Parabolic component uses separate Step/Maximum for bullish vs bearish phases. The historical bar scan for close signals is O(bars) per signal check and must be replicated. The MM parameter dual-mode (negative=fixed lot, positive=deposit fraction) must be handled. TradeAlgorithms.mqh logic for position open/close with deviation control needs faithful replication.
